object.attr: stakeholder: a full disk or a crash must not leave a truncated requirement. Since 0.2.0. A power loss is the next requirement. The failure analysis expects the GUI commit dialog's put-back of the manifest to be a plain write (CF-S34): its test case must cover that path.
object.description: If a write of a file fails, or Mellon stops during the write, Mellon shall leave the file holding either its content before the write or the full content written.
